classes.name: BRepToIGESBRep_Entity
classes.summary: provides methods to transfer BRep entity from CASCADE to IGESBRep.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the contents of the fields.

instanceMethods.name: AddVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Stores <myvertex> in "myVertices" Returns the index of <myvertex>.

instanceMethods.name: TransferEdgeList
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Edge entity from `TopoDS` to IGES.

instanceMethods.name: AddEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Stores <myedge> in "myEdges" and <mycurve3d> in "myCurves". Returns the index of <myedge>.

instanceMethods.name: TransferShape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the result of the transfert of any Shape If the transfer has failed, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Edge entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferEdge
instanceMethods.signature: (myedge: TopoDS_Edge, myface: TopoDS_Face, length: number): IGESData_IGESEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Edge entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferWire
instanceMethods.signature: (mywire: TopoDS_Wire, myface: TopoDS_Face, length: number): IGESSolid_Loop
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Wire entity from `TopoDS` to IGES. Returns the curve associated to mywire in the parametric space of myface. If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferFace
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Face entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferShell
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Shell entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferSolid
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Solid entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferCompSolid
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an CompSolid entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferCompound
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Compound entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.
